packageRules.description: typescript-eslint 8 only accepts TypeScript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0; TypeScript 7 broke npm ci. Raise this when typescript-eslint supports newer versions.
Typings must match the Node.js inside the oldest supported VS Code (engines.vscode ^1.96.0 ships Node 20), or code can use APIs that don't exist at runtime. Raise together with engines.vscode.
